name: Smart fortwo
sources: ADAC car catalogue, fortwo 453 1.0 (11/14-05/18): length 2.695, width 1.663 (1.893 with mirrors), height 1.555, wheelbase 1.873 m; rear parking sensors were an option. https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/smart/fortwo/453/242476/

Daimler's 2014 launch release (reprinted by Global Brands Magazine): turning circle 6.95 m kerb to kerb, 7.30 m wall to wall. https://www.globalbrandsmagazine.com/the-new-smart-fortwo-and-forfour-adding-a-new-shine-to-a-proven-concept/
auto-data.net, fortwo III coupé 1.0 71 hp: track 1.469 m front, 1.430 m rear; overhangs 0.424 m front, 0.398 m rear. https://www.auto-data.net/de/smart-fortwo-iii-coupe-c453-1.0-71hp-23817
notes: Rear-axle frame: x forward from the rear axle, z to the right, metres. The steering lock comes from the 6.95 m kerb-to-kerb circle; the 7.30 m wall-to-wall circle then places the front corners. ADAC gives 7.0 m and auto motor und sport measured 7.2 / 7.1 m (left / right lock). One track for all four wheels: the front one, which sets the kerb circle.
estimates: the outline between the published length and width: its front corners are placed so the body sweeps the published 7.30 m
the mirrors' size, place and height
the tyres (from the 165/65 R15 fronts) and the kerb weight
